name: Michigan Mini 1 2023
information:
THIS COMPETITION TAKES PLACE ON FRIDAY NIGHT!

We recognize that not everyone will be able to arrive at 6PM. Please indicate your expected arrival time in your registration comments. We will create groups based on this information and hope to allow everyone arriving before 7:30 to compete in all the events. 

Please do your best to arrive as early as reasonably possible for you. If we feel like too many people are showing up as late as they possibly can, we will need to reconsider the format of these competitions in the future. 


Free parking is available on site
